title: Land Development (Amendment)
long_title: AN ACT TO AMEND THE LAND DEVELOPMENT ORDINANCE

edition.caveat: private republisher, not the Government Printer

body.heading: Short title
body.raw_text: 1. This Act may be cited as the Land Development (Amendment) Act, No. 9 of 1995.
body.text: This Act may be cited as the Land Development (Amendment) Act, No. 9 of 1995.

body.heading: Amendment of section 19 of Chapter 464
body.raw_text: 2. Section 19 of the Land Development Ordinance (hereinafter referred to as the "principal enactment") is hereby amended in subsection (3) of that section by the substitution for the words " The Government Agent shall" of that section of the following:-
body.text: Section 19 of the Land Development Ordinance (hereinafter referred to as the "principal enactment") is hereby amended in subsection (3) of that section by the substitution for the words " The Government Agent shall" of that section of the following:-

children.raw_text: " The Government Agent shall in addition, cause the permit to be registered ; no fee shall be paid or recovered for such registration.".
children.text: " The Government Agent shall in addition, cause the permit to be registered ; no fee shall be paid or recovered for such registration.".

body.heading: Repeal of section 28 of the principal enactment.
body.raw_text: 3. Section 28 of the principal enactment is hereby repealed-
body.text: Section 28 of the principal enactment is hereby repealed-

body.heading: Replacement of section 30 of the principal enactment.
body.raw_text: 4. Section 30 of the principal enactment is hereby repealed and the following new section substituted therefor: - Grant to contain description of the land alienated.
body.text: Section 30 of the principal enactment is hereby repealed and the following new section substituted therefor: - Grant to contain description of the land alienated.

children.raw_text: 30. Every grant on which a land is to be alienated shall contain the extent and a description of the boundaries of such land. ".
children.text: 30. Every grant on which a land is to be alienated shall contain the extent and a description of the boundaries of such land. ".

body.heading: Sinhala text to prevail in case of inconsistency.
body.raw_text: 5. In the event of any inconsistency between the Sinhala and Tamil texts of this Act, the Sinhala text shall prevail
body.text: In the event of any inconsistency between the Sinhala and Tamil texts of this Act, the Sinhala text shall prevail
